core_obligations: Choose a surjection $F \to M$ with $F$ a free $R$-module (proof line 2044).
Use the splitting of the completed sequence to write $M^\wedge$ as a direct summand of $F^\wedge$, reducing the statement to the free module (proof lines 2044-2047).
Apply the result on completions of direct sums of copies of $R$ to conclude flatness and the Mittag-Leffler condition (proof lines 2047-2049).
proof_roadmap: Choice of a free cover (proof line 2044).
Completion as a direct summand (proof lines 2044-2047).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that over a Noetherian $I$-adically complete ring, the $I$-adic completion of a flat module whose reduction modulo $I$ is projective over $R/I$ is again flat and satisfies the Mittag-Leffler condition (statement lines 2029-2041). The proof picks a free cover, uses the splitting of the completed sequence to reduce to that free module, and quotes the case of a completion of a direct sum. The reduction by splitting is the substance, so the claim is H2.
